analyst.summary: PG Electroplast is a fast-growing contract manufacturer for consumer-durable brands (ACs, washing machines and related components), riding a genuine India outsourcing/PLI tailwind - but the headline multi-year growth rate is not what's happening right now. Over the last year, revenue growth slowed to single digits while profit actually fell around 32% as the company absorbs the costs of an aggressive, debt-funded capacity build-out (negative free cash flow, rising borrowings, compressed margins). None of this looks like an accounting problem - it looks like a normal, if painful, investment phase - but at roughly 90 times earnings, the market is pricing in a smooth return to the old growth-and-margin trajectory that has not yet been demonstrated. A Hold, with the clear caveat that the trailing 3-year growth rate is not a safe guide to what comes next.
